planning_notes: Board is Arduino UNO. Wiring is preserved: buttons D2/D3, PWM LED D9, TM1637 CLK=D4/DIO=D5. D13 is included because it was explicitly inventoried as a digital_output role; model may decide whether to use it.

Because no electrical polarity (active-low vs active-high) or pull-up wiring details were provided, digital inputs assume pullup enabled and active_high=true, meaning model 'pressed' corresponds to electrical HIGH. This matches a common UNO button-to-GND + INPUT_PULLUP pattern; if your wiring is reversed, SysML must adjust interpretation accordingly.

No explicit initial mode/parameter values were given; TM1637 initial is set to 1 as a safe placeholder for 'mode number' until SysML defines the mapping. PWM initial is 0 to ensure LEDs start off safely.
Control period is set to 5 ms to support smooth breathing control without creating unnecessary scheduling granularity; SysML implements all mode transitions and parameter updates.
No serial interface requirements were provided for this task; serial_channels is left empty.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Mode switch button (D2) pressed event; D2 cycles mode between 常灭/常亮/呼吸灯

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Parameter adjust button (D3) for current mode (brightness or breathing speed)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: PWM LED D9 intensity output (used for 常灭/常亮/呼吸灯)

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Status LED on D13 (wired but not specified in prose; used by model if needed)

interfaces.name: io_4
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 display current mode number or current parameter value (model-defined content)

interfaces.name: io_5
interfaces.meaning: Actual delta since previous control step

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 实现一个双按钮模式控制的 LED 系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、PWM LED D9 和 TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）。D2 切换三种模式：常灭、常亮、呼吸灯；D3 用于调整当前模式参数，如常亮亮度或呼吸速度；数码管显示当前模式编号或参数值。
